newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard Air December load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard Air December load factor rises.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc on Thursday said its passenger load factor rose 9.78 points in December to 60.05 percent from 50.27 percent in the same month of 1995.
Revenue passenger miles increased 73.6 percent to 54 million from 31.2 million, and available seat miles grew 45 percent to 90.2 million from 62.1 million.

Year to date, the load factor was up 9.69 points at 61.27 percent from 51.58 percent. Revenue passenger miles rose 130 percent to 667.8 million from 290.0 million, and available seat miles increased 94 percent to 1.09 billion from 562.3 million.
